keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Borussia Dortmund).
Delay in match (Borussia M'gladbach).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Joane Gadou (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Zento Uno (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Borussia M'gladbach 0, Borussia Dortmund 0.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Mathieu Nguefack replaces Zento Uno.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Waldemar Anton replaces Joane Gadou.
Second Half begins Borussia M'gladbach 0, Borussia Dortmund 0.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Joey Veerman replaces Jobe Bellingham.
Kevin Diks (Borussia M'gladbach) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Mathis Albert replaces Fábio Silva.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Marcel Sabitzer replaces Konstantinos Karetsas.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Isac Lidberg replaces Shuto Machino.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. David Herold replaces Robin Hack.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Franck Honorat replaces Jens Castrop.
Goal! Borussia M'gladbach 0, Borussia Dortmund 1. Felix Nmecha (Borussia Dortmund) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Borussia M'gladbach. Nicolas Kühn replaces Joe Scally.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Ethan Nwaneri replaces Maximilian Beier.
Second Half ends, Borussia M'gladbach 0, Borussia Dortmund 1.
